qde_v2.finding: negative-leaning, single-subject-dominated (subject 2 outlier flips aggregate mean sign vs 7/10-subject majority direction)

rationale: QDE V2 completed with a real, reproducible, honestly-reported (negative-leaning) result. GalaxyPPG could not be trained due to a genuine, reproduced, host-specific network access failure (zenodo.org), not a design or protocol flaw - the frozen protocol remains valid and ready to execute once access is available. Per Section 46, a blocked GalaxyPPG download does not invalidate the completed QDE V2 science, and per Section 91 independent downstream work (Stage 3) continues.
